initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production transparent inventory icon for the existing fantasy browser game Heroes of Ether. Create ONE open soft drawstring booster pouch, upright three-quarter front view, centered, entire silhouette visible with a modest clear transparent margin. Full, rounded fabric body fills the lower two thirds, exactly THREE distinct booster objects emerge from its open mouth in an uncluttered fan. Match a polished illustrated fantasy mobile game: clean firm purple-brown outlines, large smooth color facets, bright rounded highlights, warm gold metal accents, readable shapes when displayed at 74 to 124 pixels. Smooth painted material without grain, microtextures or tiny ornament. Not photorealistic. No chest, box, coins, writing, numbers, labels, pedestal, background scene, particles, light rays, background glow or large cast shadow. Genuine transparent alpha outside the icon. Each emerging booster remains recognizable, not fused with the bag. The drawstring has a simple neat knot. Square composition. COMMON BOOSTER POUCH: practical moss-green soft fabric bag with warm tan leather rim and modest bronze cord tips, one small round bronze clasp. Three boosters: a large polished silver curved grappling HOOK with a little golden rope (left), a pink and lavender striped wrapped CANDY (right), and a small blue faceted six-armed ice SNOWFLAKE with a gold center (middle, tallest). Bag visibly simple and friendly. Exactly these 3 items, each partly tucked inside; no other boosters.
